messages:
maya: Quick decision needed: do we run a 2-week hotfix sprint or batch fixes into next sprint with enhancements? Sheet: https://tiny.redwood/backlog

ajay: Hotfix sprint for anything blocking core flow or named customer. No debate.

courtney: Proposed quick rubric: P0=data loss/crash, P1=core workflow break or enterprise blocker, P2=degraded UX/perf, P3=polish/feature. regressions bump one level.

ben: Add requirement: DB-touching fixes need a safety owner and smoke script.

sara: I'll own canaries + smoke. Can we reserve Thu 08:30-09:30 UTC?

oliver: For enhancements, mark fast-win (<=3 dev-days) vs research (>3d). Fast-wins can be pulled into the hotfix sprint only if they unblock customers.

maya: Plan: lock 2-week hotfix sprint for P0-P1 items starting Monday. Owners ajay + ben + sara. Court and oliver own enhancement queue. Owners update ticket with owner, estimate, and rollout note by EOD. If anyone disputes severity call it out now.
